title: A Service of Sorrow (World Trade Center Response)
description: In this sermon, the preacher emphasizes the foundation of hope for believers, which is the unbreakable love of God in Christ Jesus. He highlights that nothing can separate us from this love, not even death or suffering. The preacher also emphasizes the importance of obedience to the gospel of God and warns of the judgment that will begin with the household of God. He encourages the congregation to trust their souls to the faithful Creator and reminds them that their hope is based on the fact that God did not spare His own Son but delivered Him for us all.
